description: This file is a minified JavaScript source code for the Yahoo! User Interface (YUI) library's History utility module (version 2.9.1). It manages URL hash-based navigation and browser history, providing functions for initializing history management, navigating, and handling state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initialize the history module with a DOM element and optional iframe for older IE versions.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigate to a new state by updating the URL hash.

methods.name: multiNavigate
methods.description: Navigate to multiple states in one call.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieve the current state of a registered module.

methods.name: getBookmarkedState
methods.description: Get the bookmarked state for a given key from the URL hash.

methods.name: getQueryStringParameter
methods.description: Extract a parameter value from the URL query string.
